1  village, Tiruppur District, Kangeyam Cross Road, measuring an exten  1428 sq. ft., along with a building, in consonance with the present  value.

For Petitioner : Mr.D.Monisha  For Respondents : Mr.G.Krishna Raja,
 Additional Government Pleader  ORDER
The land that belonged to the petitioner was acquired for public purposes.

An Award was passed by the third respondent-Special District Revenue Officer (Land Acquisition) in proceedings dated 31.01.2023.
2.
Not satisfied with the Award of compensation, the petitioner filed an objection before the District Collector on 30.03.2023.
In respect of such objections, the Competent Authority / District Collector has to refer the matter for adjudication before the Court concerned under Section 20 of the Land Acquisition Act.

3. In the present case, the petitioner has submitted the objections by affixing the prescribed fee on 30.03.2023 and that being the https://www.mhc.tn.gov.in/judis factum, the District Collector is directed to refer the dispute for adjudication under the provisions of the Act, within a period of four weeks from the date of receipt of a copy of this order.
4. The petitioner is at liberty to adjudicate the issues on merits and in accordance with law before the Competent Authority.

5. With the above liberty, the writ petition stands disposed of.
However, there shall be no order as to costs.
